name: zpulse
description: Zcash network observatory: shielded supply integrity, turnstile migration, and per-block privacy mix, live from a Zcash node.

scripts.node:start: docker start zpulse-zebrad 2>/dev/null || docker run -d --name zpulse-zebrad -p 8232:8232 -p 8233:8233 -e ZEBRA_RPC__LISTEN_ADDR=0.0.0.0:8232 -e ZEBRA_RPC__ENABLE_COOKIE_AUTH=false -e ZEBRA_CONSENSUS__CHECKPOINT_SYNC=true -v zebrad-data:/home/zebra/.cache/zebra docker.io/zfnd/zebra:latest zebrad start
scripts.node:stop: docker stop zpulse-zebrad 2>/dev/null && docker rm zpulse-zebrad 2>/dev/null
